newsitem.title: UK: Oftel determines BT's costs for portability.
newsitem.headline: Oftel determines BT's costs for portability.

text.p: UK telecoms watchdog Oftel said on Thursday that it had determined British Telecommunications Plc's cost and charges for geographic number portability up to March 1997.

The issue of number portability, which is the ability of customers to retain their telephone numbers when changing operators, was referred to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC) in April 1995.
BT's licence was amended to facilitate the introduction of number portability as a result of the reference to the MMC.
Under the licence, Oftel determines BT's reasonable costs in providing portability.
